snippet.title: Wolfenstein: Enemy Territory Single-Player - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Return to Castle Wolfenstein mod. Released 11.19.21 for RTCW | iortcw (Windows, Mac, Linux), RealRTCW (Windows), RTCW-Touch (Android), RTCW4A (Android), vitaRTCW (PlayStation Vita) and RTCWQuest (Oculus Quest), and 11.30.21 for RTCWCoop (Windows, Mac, Linux) and RealRTCWCoop (Windows) - on Steam and Mod DB.

ℹ️ Wolfenstein: Enemy Territory Single-Player & Cooperative is a free expansion for Return to Castle Wolfenstein - what could have been the cut single-player campaign of Wolfenstein: Enemy Territory.

Please visit https://www.moddb.com/mods/et for more information.

⏲ 0:00 - Introduction
⏲ 0:05 - Trailer
⏲ 3:20 - Release
